scope: Proposition 4.3 (Finite evolution and its identities) of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness with local conservation for the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-with-local-conservation-for-the-hard-sphere-Boltzmann-equation-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 363 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 640850bc08703544), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For fixed N, b, T, λ, the colored equations have a unique nonnegative local mild solution with bounded total H-norm. It continues while that norm remains bounded, with the prescribed transfers at retirement times, and depends continuously in this norm on its initial data on every common bounded interval of existence. The norm of each component is continuous between transfers. On every such interval, total mass, momentum, and energy are conserved. The exact local collision-invariant balances hold, with all polynomial velocity fluxes integrable. For ρ = M or ρ = µ, one has at every time of existence Hρ(F(t)) + Z t 0 Db (F(s)) ds ≤ Hρ(F(0)), (4.10) where Db is the entropy dissipation with the same cutoff.
